notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate an Equipment's equip ability given to it by Puresteel Paladin by paying {0}, targeting Burning-Tree Emissary.
Cowardice triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
